### 2026-10-23 – Big news, I managed to design my custom footprint and most of the time went into making the keyboards the right size so that I optimize PCB board space and that the board itself is not too expensive.

**10h**

Big news, I managed to design my custom footprint and most of the time went into making the keyboards the right size so that I optimize PCB board space and that the board itself is not too expensive. The bigger the more expensive. I also rewired everything so that when I start making the traces on the PCB, I cut down on the need for ratsnests.

### 2026-10-24 – So this is the finishing touch. I'll add art later, however I am very proud of my work. So basically, I was having a lot of trouble wiring all the components up, because the copper kept blocking the o

**5h**

So this is the finishing touch. I'll add art later, however I am very proud of my work. So basically, I was having a lot of trouble wiring all the components up, because the copper kept blocking the other ports, so I had to rearrange the whole layout so that everything connects to a port without requiring excess viases, blocking, or ratsnests. This deviated from the guide by a lot, but that just means I'd have to come up with my own solution, which is the whole idea of mechanical engineering. So, I now have my own unique board setup along with unique capacitative keys.
